critical.title: ⚡ BAH — +6.09% day and a >10% analyst target revision
critical.text: BAH closed $68.69 → $72.87 on 10/08 (+6.09%) after Truist (Tobey Sommer) upgraded Hold → Buy and raised its target $70 → $85 (+21%), citing a civil-revenue bottom and fixed-price margin expansion. Drawdown recovered rose 21.5% → 31.2%. Citi cut its target $82 → $77 (−6%) on 10/07. Consensus $84.77 is still +16.3% above spot, so the sell-zone stays 🟢 TOO EARLY; there are no shares to sell until June 2027. Lens impact: Price Zone and Upside Left remain 🟢; Peer discount narrowed ~10.0% → ~4.8%.
